description: This is a Perl module source file implementing functionalities for handling logs in a Subversion (SVN) integration within a Git environment. It contains definitions for functions related to log display, commit processing, blame annotations, and configuration management specific to SVN-Git interaction.

methods.name: cmt_showable
methods.description: Determines if a commit is showable based on its revision or completeness of its message.

methods.name: log_use_color
methods.description: Returns whether to use colored output based on current configuration.

methods.name: git_svn_log_cmd
methods.description: Constructs the git log command with appropriate options for SVN revisions and arguments.

methods.name: config_pager
methods.description: Configures the pager program for output display based on environment and settings.

methods.name: run_pager
methods.description: Runs the pager program in a child process for displaying logs or blame information.

methods.name: format_svn_date
methods.description: Formats an SVN date into human-readable string with timezone info.

methods.name: parse_git_date
methods.description: Parses and adjusts a git date string with optional timezone offset.

methods.name: set_local_timezone
methods.description: Sets or unsets the local timezone environment variable.

methods.name: tz_to_s_offset
methods.description: Converts a timezone string offset to seconds.

methods.name: get_author_info
methods.description: Extracts and stores author information from commit metadata.

methods.name: process_commit
methods.description: Decides whether to display a commit based on range filters and manages output deferment.

methods.name: show_commit
methods.description: Displays commit information in one-line or detailed format.

methods.name: show_commit_changed_paths
methods.description: Displays changed paths of a commit if available.

methods.name: show_commit_normal
methods.description: Displays a detailed commit log including author, date, message, and changes.

methods.name: cmd_show_log
methods.description: Main function to display SVN logs with range filtering, formatting, and paging.

methods.name: cmd_blame
methods.description: Displays blame annotations for a given file, highlighting commit revisions and authors.
